## Complete FASTA headers

fastars now preserves complete FASTA headers in indexes built directly from a
FASTA file. Fetched records reproduce the original header, including text after
the primary ID.

- Exact lookup accepts either the primary ID or the complete header.
- Prefix lookup can match a primary ID or the beginning of a complete header.
- `--id-regexp` searches the complete header, including descriptions.
- Records sharing a primary ID can be selected individually with an exact
  complete-header query.

Indexes containing descriptions are larger because they retain more source
metadata. Header suffixes are compressed and are omitted for records whose
header contains only a primary ID.

Indexes built from `.fai/.gzi` retain only primary IDs because `.fai` files do
not contain header descriptions. fastars v0.3.0 can read existing `.ffx`
indexes, but older fastars versions cannot read newly built indexes containing
complete headers.
